propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket omit write parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) already supported by the library and CLI, making them unreachable over MCP

FastMCP derives JSON schemas and argument models from handwritten callable signatures in _mcp_writes.py; undeclared payload keys are discarded before the adapter runs, and the adapter bodies independently forward only close_class or assignee
The MCP adapter must expose force (str | None), caused_by, ref, and reason parameters for transition, and force (str | None) for claim, and forward each unchanged to the library core functions
The 2026-08-18 operator ruling rescinds the force-denial policy, establishing parity across CLI/library/MCP with absent certification as the audit signal, while force_close remains excluded
